description: Every row of the error-text table: a missing map key (string and int), a list index out of range, a list indexed by a string, an int indexed by an int, division by zero, and modulus by zero, each an `if` condition with `on_error: continue`. Circuitry's own one-line text, identical in both engines, never a container's contents, a Python tuple repr or a Rust Debug repr.
